controles.affirmation: Litige fiscal suedois : redressement d'environ 86 M$ (837 M SEK) sur un transfert de PI de 2013, cour d'appel favorable en mai 2024, tribunal de premiere instance favorable en decembre 2025, STA a fait appel, aucune provision au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Xylem's Swedish subsidiary received a tax assessment from the Swedish Tax Agency (the "STA") for the 2013 tax year related to the tax treatment of an intercompany transfer of certain intellectual property... a decision adverse to Xylem in June 2022 for SEK 837 million (approximately $86 million USD)... on May 15, 2024, that court rendered a decision in favor of Xylem... In December 2025, the trial court issued a ruling on the remanded issue in Xylem's favor. The STA has appealed this ruling to the Administrative Court of Appeal... As of June 30, 2026, we have not recorded any unrecognized tax benefits related to this uncertain tax position.

controles.affirmation: Commandes T2 2026 : 3 086 M$, +42,0% (+40,9% organique) ; carnet total 5 315 M$, +5,9% sur un an ; hausse due a un contrat significatif dans Water Solutions and Services
controles.verbatim_source: Orders of $3,086 million, up 42.0% from $2,174 million in the prior year period, and up 40.9% on an organic basis... Total backlog was $5,315 million at June 30, 2026, an increase of $297 million, or 5.9%, as compared to June 30, 2025 backlog of $5,018 million... including the securing of a significant contract in Water Solutions and Services during the three months ended June 30, 2026.

controles.affirmation: Les trois autres segments ont recule ou stagne (Water Infrastructure -3,9%, Measurement and Control Solutions +2,4%, Applied Water +9,2%)
controles.verbatim_source: Tableau Orders T2 2026, Organic Impact : Water Infrastructure (26) / (3.9)% ; Applied Water 45 / 9.2% ; Measurement and Control Solutions 10 / 2.4% ; Water Solutions and Services 850 / 147.3%. Total change in orders : Applied Water +50 M$ / +10.2%
controles.correction_proposee: La qualification est contredite par les chiffres cites dans la meme phrase : Applied Water progresse de 9,2% en organique et de 10,2% au total. Ecrire : 'un segment recule (Water Infrastructure -3,9%), un stagne (Measurement and Control Solutions +2,4%) et Applied Water croit de 9,2%, mais aucun ne pese face aux +147,3% de Water Solutions and Services'.

controles.affirmation: La dette totale passe de 1 942 M$ a 2 926 M$, meme si elle reste modeste face aux 11,5 Mds$ de capitaux propres du groupe
controles.verbatim_source: Bilan consolide au 30 juin 2026 / 31 decembre 2025 : Total stockholders' equity 10,421 / 11,480 ; Total equity 10,424 / 11,491 ; Total debt 2,926 / 1,942
controles.correction_proposee: Les 11,5 Mds$ sont les capitaux propres au 31 decembre 2025. Au 30 juin 2026, date de la dette de 2 926 M$, les capitaux propres sont de 10,4 Mds$ (10 421 M$), en baisse de 1,1 Md$ sur six mois du fait des rachats d'actions. Remplacer 11,5 Mds$ par 10,4 Mds$.

controles.affirmation: Obligations senior emises le 29 mai 2026 a 5,20% et 5,45%, a comparer aux 1,95% a 3,25% des obligations emises entre 2016 et 2020 encore en circulation
controles.verbatim_source: 3.250% Senior Notes due 2026 : 500 ; 1.950% Senior Notes due 2028 : 500 ; 2.250% Senior Notes due 2031 : 500 ; 4.375% Senior Notes due 2046 : 400. 10-K FY2025 : 'On October 11, 2016, we issued 3.250% Senior Notes of $500 million aggregate principal amount due October 2026 and 4.375% Senior Notes of $400 million aggregate principal amount due October 2046'
controles.correction_proposee: La fourchette omet les 400 M$ d'obligations 4,375% echeance 2046, emises le 11 octobre 2016 et toujours en circulation, ce qui gonfle artificiellement l'ecart de cout. Ecrire : 'a comparer aux 1,95% a 4,375% des obligations plus anciennes encore en circulation'.

controles.affirmation: Marge nette T2 2026 de 11,3% contre 9,8%, portee en partie par la baisse du nombre d'actions en circulation liee aux rachats (diluees 236,6 M contre 243,9 M)
controles.verbatim_source: Net income attributable to Xylem 263 (T2 2026) / 226 (T2 2025) ; Revenue 2,336 / 2,301 ; Diluted weighted average shares 236.6 / 243.9
controles.correction_proposee: Les chiffres de marge (11,3% vs 9,8%, +150 pb) sont exacts, mais le raisonnement ne tient pas : le nombre d'actions n'entre pas dans le calcul de la marge nette (resultat net / chiffre d'affaires). Il n'agit que sur le BPA. Supprimer l'attribution aux rachats d'actions, ou la deplacer vers un commentaire sur le BPA.

controles.affirmation: Rachat de 10,5 millions d'actions pour 1 243 M$ au S1 2026 contre 13 M$ un an plus tot ; dette totale de 1 942 M$ a 2 926 M$ ; 1 000 M$ d'obligations emises le 29 mai 2026
controles.verbatim_source: we repurchased... 10.5 million shares of common stock for $1,243 million... For the three and six months ended June 30, 2025, the Company repurchased... 0.1 million shares of common stock for $13 million... On May 29, 2026, we issued $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.200% Senior Notes due June 1, 2033 and $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.450% Senior Notes due June 1, 2036. Total debt 2,926 / 1,942

controles.affirmation: Croissance organique S1 2026 de 0,5% (21 M$ sur 4 461 M$), sous l'objectif annuel de 2% a 4% annonce en fevrier 2026 ; organique quasi nul au T1, +1,3% au T2
controles.verbatim_source: Organic revenue increased $30 million, or 1.3%, and $21 million, or 0.5% for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 (10-Q T2 2026). 10-K FY2025 : 'We anticipate total revenue growth of 1% to 3% in 2026, with organic revenue growth anticipated to be in the range of 2% to 4%.'
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le 10-Q T1 2026 indique 'Organic revenue decreased $9 million, or 0.4%'. Le T1 n'etait pas 'quasi nul' mais legerement negatif ; l'ecrire ainsi renforcerait l'anti-these.

controles.affirmation: Cession de l'activite comptage international en mai 2026 pour une perte cumulee de 37 M$ ; cession Evoqua Magneto en 2025 pour une perte de 8 M$ ; 17,3 Mds$ d'actifs totaux
controles.verbatim_source: As a result of the sale, the Company recognized a cumulative loss of $37 million, of which $23 million was recognized during the year ended December 31, 2025, and the remaining $14 million was recognized during 2026. Total assets $17,342. 10-K FY2025 : 'we recorded an additional loss of $8 million, reflecting the impact of the final working capital adjustment'
controles.correction_proposee: Imprecision mineure : le 10-K parle d'une perte ADDITIONNELLE de 8 M$ liee a l'ajustement final du besoin en fonds de roulement, pas de la perte totale sur la cession Magneto. Ecrire 'une perte complementaire de 8 M$'.

controles.affirmation: Glossaire IEEPA : tarifs juges illegaux par la Cour supreme des Etats-Unis en fevrier 2026
controles.verbatim_source: In February 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that certain tariffs previously imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act ("IEEPA") were unlawful.
